Full Feature Map

Everything, done in one place.

From display views to Backlog Quest, here's every feature of Backlog My Tasks in one place.

📊 Display Views (7)

  • Home / Calendar
  • Matrix / Gantt
  • Kanban / Summary
  • Burndown (everything updates automatically when you switch tabs)

✏️ Task Actions

  • Change Status, Assignee & Due Date
  • Quick Edit / Bulk Actions
  • Right-Click Menu / Duplicate
  • Pin / Snooze / Notes

⏱ Tracking, Notifications & Detection

  • Time Tracking
  • Automatic New-Comment Detection
  • Due-Date Desktop Notifications
  • Slack / Teams integration / Badges

🔍 Search & Filter

  • Full-Text Search on Title & Key
  • Space / Project / Assignee
  • Quick Filter Chips
  • Filter Presets

👑 Dashboard

  • Data Management
  • Per-Project Dashboard
  • Cross-Space Summary
  • User List (admin only)

⚙️ Foundation & General Settings

  • 5-language support / Dark mode
  • “Treat Processed as Complete” Toggle
  • Offline support (auto-resend)
  • API key encrypted with AES-256

🎮 Backlog Quest

  • 8 classes, level up
  • Gear Collection & Avatar Updates
  • Boss Battles & Hidden Bosses
  • Pet Raising & Achievements

You can make full use of every bit of it, without any strain.

Start with whichever features you'll actually use. Before you know it, it's part of your everyday routine.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
